opportunities.title: Seed and hoe planned row crops
opportunities.summary: Sow mapped rows and remove weeds around recorded plant positions on prepared soil.

reviewLinks.rationale: FD20 combines sowing-position recording and mechanical inter/intra-row weeding.
limitations: Crop, seed/tool package and seasonal field capacity require validation.

opportunities.title: Mechanically weed vegetable rows
opportunities.summary: Guide compatible cultivation tools along mapped vegetable rows, with human setup and crop-clearance checks.

reviewLinks.rationale: Current OZ specifies mapped RTK operation and mechanical weeding implements.
limitations: Tools and soil conditions determine coverage; user handles preparation and exceptions.

opportunities.title: Spot-spray selected plants in supported crops
opportunities.summary: Use a driver-operated tractor and vision-controlled implement to treat detected targets selectively.

reviewLinks.rationale: ARA 620 recognizes targets and controls individual nozzles.
limitations: Driver, crop software and approved treatment remain necessary; no autonomous tractor claim.
